setup_scope: Preconditioner construction plus solver/operator/CG workspaces, input upload, and optional FP32 matrix copy. Excludes mesh assembly, reference loading, host random-start generation/input fingerprinting, graph capture and warmup. JIT work is included where encountered; these are not warmed setup measurements. Historical setup_seconds is an alias for preconditioner_setup_seconds.
memory_scope: Device free-memory decrease from after fixture preparation through preconditioner/workspace setup and capture. Includes allocator pools/runtime/JIT allocations; excludes original fixture storage and CuPy adapter. Not peak memory or a pure live-workspace count.
pool_memory_scope: Warp CUDA pool counters only, excluding driver/context allocations. The high-water counter covers the whole process, including fixture preparation; it is not the setup interval peak. Missing counters are null. Upstream FSAI can consume substantial device memory outside this pool.
first_solve_compute_scope: Preconditioner/workspace setup + capture (including its eager preparation) + first captured solve. Original equations/spectrum and native stopping are checked after this first output outside the timed phase. Excludes mesh assembly, reference construction/loading, host input fingerprinting, host validation and initial imports. Cached compilation where available; not total process wall time. Historical warmup_seconds now measures this independently validated first replay.

graph.method: CUDA graph DOT inspection; not a CUDA API trace

cupy_adapter.reference_setup_scope: CuPy matrix/start/constraint upload, LinearOperator, and inner adapter workspaces/capture. Excludes supplied FSAI/base CG construction, library imports, and outer eigensolve warmup.
cupy_adapter.pool_memory_scope: Process-local Warp pool used-memory delta during adapter construction; excludes graph/driver and non-pool allocations. Not peak memory.
cupy_adapter.memory_scope: Device free-memory decrease during adapter setup, including graph/runtime allocations; not a peak measurement.
cupy_adapter.setup_scope: Extra inner adapter workspace/capture only. Shifted matrix and FSAI factors are shared with the completed Warp trial; active-width CG states are preallocated before timing. This is not independent end-to-end CuPy setup.
cupy_adapter.stopping: CuPy uses absolute residual tolerance and converges its entire starting block; independent original-problem gates check the first k modes. Warp uses normalized stopping on k modes.

timing_note: Warm replay wall times; setup/capture separate. CuPy converges its entire starting block; Warp stops on the first k. Contended or numerically rejected runs are not performance evidence.

request.guard_policy: Fresh FEM fixture applies current full boundary-cluster and positive-guard policy after loading full independent reference arrays.

independent_reference_cache.scope: Independent CPU reference only; original equations and mass orthogonality checked on every use. Assembly, cluster/nullity policy and backend factors remain fresh. Entire cache preparation is outside backend setup/solve timing.

metric_qr_scope: Explicit complete two-pass QR control (metric-defect 0), installed default (--installed-default), or benchmark-only fresh computed-metric defect check. The latter reuses X and cached AX only after a finite device check, retaining fresh MX; other cases run the complete original QR. Computed-metric bounds do not certify exact-arithmetic physical products. All original physical/native/rank gates remain. Conditional fallback is restricted to owned Warp mass operators. Each worker owns its preconditioner/solver; only independently verified CPU references are reused outside timing. Counters are read during post-solve validation, outside compute timing. With --wide-only, widths outside96..256 retain original QR with no added control arrays or graph nodes. Installed default additionally guards Ada SM89, chunk4096, tol>=1e-11, image reuse and symmetric products. With --cupy, only the installed-default Warp policy is compared. CuPy uses the supplied Warp preconditioner/base CG, so its adapter setup excludes those shared factors and is not an independent total setup cost. QR usage counters are attached only to Warp validation, never CuPy rows.
